title: Deterministic Tool-Boundary Gates for Agentic Package-Install Hallucination
supported_claim: On measured PyPI/NPM package-install command-string corpora, a deterministic tool-boundary gate blocked invalid or policy-unsafe model-generated install strings with zero observed hardened invalid-package escapes while preserving high valid-command utility.

heldout_third_model_boundary.interpretation: Boundary evidence only; excluded from the positive PX-050 claim.

px050r_strict_repair.strict_gate_interpretation: Registered strict one-line promotion gate failed because raw StarCoder2 outputs rarely met exact one-line command compliance.

px050s_controller_extractor_repair.interpretation: Positive deployment-repair evidence. Controller target extraction plus hardened verifier passed on a fresh StarCoder2 held-out namespace; this is not a raw-output third-model replication claim.

px050t_controller_adaptive_stress.interpretation: Positive crafted command-string stress evidence for the controller/extractor repair; this is not live-agent evidence.

px050u_live_agent_tool_boundary.interpretation: Positive dry-run live-agent-style tool-call evidence for the controller/extractor repair; no generated package-manager command was executed.

px050v_second_model_live_agent_tool_boun.interpretation: Positive second-model dry-run live-agent-style tool-call evidence for the controller/extractor repair; no generated package-manager command was executed.

px050_live_agent_two_model_final_determi.interpretation: Promote PX-050 as the lead Praxis defense result with a bounded no-execution two-model live-agent tool-call claim.

claim_boundary: No general software supply-chain security claim.
Raw and strict held-out StarCoder2 promotion gates failed and are boundary evidence.
PX-050S controller/extractor repair is positive deployment-repair evidence, not raw-output third-model replication.
PX-050T adaptive stress is crafted command-string evidence, not live-agent evidence.
PX-050U/PX-050V live-agent tool-boundary evidence is dry-run tool-call evidence, not package-manager execution or broad agent-safety evidence.
